Dedicated verify should check 411 documents, filename/frontmatter/title/section ID agreement, unique IDs per package, link existence, reverse UC/API associations, rule sequence, no inline backticks or generic API/BR identities, no Not specified markers, exact None in no-API UC.
Compare normalized formal expression bodies before/after: ignore BR constraint renaming and moved provenance lines only; preserve UML visibility, arrows and arithmetic minus.
Check per-UC local UML classifier/member closure where supported; do not trigger unrelated domain/model/schema rewrites.
